knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

## Run Metadata

- **Run Date / Timestamp**: `r params$timestamp`
- **Executed By**: `r params$run_user`
- **R Version**: `r R.version.string`

## Detailed Notes & Justification

```{r notes, results='asis'}
cat(params$detailed_notes)
```

## Audit Log Summary (Records Modified in Oracle)

The table below summarizes all DML operations captured by triggers during this execution window:

```{r audit_table}
if (!is.null(params$audit_summary) && nrow(params$audit_summary) > 0) {
  # Normalize column names in case summary columns vary in casing
  summary_df <- params$audit_summary
  colnames(summary_df) <- toupper(colnames(summary_df))
  
  knitr::kable(summary_df)
} else {
  cat("_No audit trigger records recorded for this time window._")
}
```

---

## Summary of Taxonomic Changes

```{r tax_changes}
if (!is.null(params$taxonomic_changes) && nrow(params$taxonomic_changes) > 0) {
  changes_df <- params$taxonomic_changes
  colnames(changes_df) <- toupper(colnames(changes_df))
  
  current_year <- as.numeric(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"))
  
  if ("YEAR_CHANGED" %in% colnames(changes_df)) {
    changes_this_year <- changes_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(as.numeric(YEAR_CHANGED) == current_year)
  } else {
    changes_this_year <- changes_df
  }
  
  if (nrow(changes_this_year) > 0) {
    knitr::kable(changes_this_year)
  } else {
    cat("_No taxonomic renames or synonymizations recorded for the current year._")
  }
} else {
  cat("_No taxonomic changes table provided._")
}
```

## Taxon Group Stanzas & Composition

`TAXON_GROUP_COMPOSITION` identifies member taxa purely by `GROUP_STANZA_ID` and `SPECIES_CODE` (linked to `TAXON_GROUP_STANZAS` for temporal ranges and `GROUP_CODE`).

```{r group_info}
has_stanzas <- !is.null(params$group_stanzas) && nrow(params$group_stanzas) > 0
has_comp    <- !is.null(params$group_composition) && nrow(params$group_composition) > 0

if (has_stanzas || has_comp) {
  if (has_stanzas) {
    stanzas_df <- params$group_stanzas
    colnames(stanzas_df) <- toupper(colnames(stanzas_df))
    cat("### Stanzas Updated\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(head(stanzas_df, 20), caption = "Taxon Group Stanzas (first 20 rows shown)"))
  }
  
  if (has_comp) {
    comp_df <- params$group_composition
    colnames(comp_df) <- toupper(colnames(comp_df))
    
    # Ensure only existing columns (GROUP_STANZA_ID, SPECIES_CODE, plus OPERATION if staged) are selected
    comp_display <- comp_df %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c("GROUP_STANZA_ID", "SPECIES_CODE", "OPERATION")))
    
    cat("\n### Composition Membership Summary\n\n")
    cat(sprintf("Total composition records staged/updated: %d\n\n", nrow(comp_display)))
    print(knitr::kable(head(comp_display, 20), caption = "Taxon Group Composition (first 20 rows shown)"))
  }
} else {
  cat("_No specific group composition delta tables passed to report parameters._")
}
```
